correspondence: lean/docs/369.md (SHA-256 3a79656f6ff91a6f) names as its accompanying paper(s) “Strict hot spots and absence of interior critical points on smooth simply connected planar domains”, lists the comparator statement lean/ComparatorChallenges/HotSpots.lean (SHA-256 ef8a14d3717c0acf) for “Strict hot spots and absence of interior critical points”, and says: “The strict hot-spots conjecture asks whether extrema of a first nonconstant Neumann eigenfunction occur only on the boundary. The formalization proves the stronger interior statement on every nonempty smooth bounded simply connected planar domain: every nonzero eigenfunction in the first positive Neumann eigenspace has nonvanishing gradient throughout the interior. Consequently all global maxima and minima lie on the boundary. The conclusion applies to every eigenfunction even when the eigenvalue is multiple.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
